name: api-response-simulator
description: API Response Simulator — Chrome extension that intercepts HTTP requests and returns fake responses

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.bridge.config.ts
scripts.build:watch: concurrently "vite build --watch" "vite build --watch --config vite.content.config.ts" "vite build --watch --config vite.bridge.config.ts"
